title: The Beginning
description: Aasan Saravanan T. opens the first Gurushethra dojo in Chennai with a small group of dedicated students and a vision to preserve traditional Okinawan Goju-Ryu Karate in Tamil Nadu.

title: First State Results
description: GIMA students represent Chennai at the Tamil Nadu State Karate Championship for the first time — a turning point that established Gurushethra as a serious training academy.

title: National Recognition
description: GIMA athletes qualify for the National Karate Championship, earning recognition at the highest level of Indian competition and raising the academy's profile across Tamil Nadu.

title: Second Centre Opens
description: Growing demand from the Chitlapakkam community leads to GIMA's expansion, bringing structured traditional karate training to a new area of Chennai.

title: International Milestones
description: Aasan Saravanan T. is awarded the VII Dan Black Belt in Malaysia — a prestigious international recognition of his mastery and decades of dedication to Goju-Ryu Karate.

title: Four Centres, Growing Family
description: With four training centres across Chennai — Chromepet, Chitlapakkam, and Nemilichery — GIMA continues to build champions of character and competition throughout the city.
